title: FDI releases concise two-page summary of advice sheet on STDs and the oral cavity
html:
Sexually transmitted infections (STIs) remain a major global public health concern, particularly among adolescents and young adults. Because several STIs can present with oral manifestations, dental professionals are uniquely positioned to contribute to their early detection, patient education and appropriate referral. 

To support dental teams in this important role, FDI has released a new concise two-page summary of its advice sheet Sexually Transmitted Diseases and the Oral Cavity. 

Designed as a practical resource for dentists and dental teams, the summary brings together the key information from the advice sheet in a quick-reference format. It outlines the main sexually transmitted diseases that may affect the oral cavity—including chlamydia, gonorrhoea, syphilis, hepatitis, HIV, herpes simplex virus and human papillomavirus (HPV)—and highlights their oral manifestations, prevention strategies and the role of dental professionals in early detection and timely referral. 

Whether used as a quick chairside reference or an advocacy resource, the two-page summary empowers dental professionals to support wider public health efforts and forms part of FDI's broader commitment to providing practical, evidence-based guidance that supports better patient care.

Download the two-page summary or revisit the full report to explore the findings in more detail:
